findings.label: low_pe_cycle_can_be_real_when_duration_and_price_state_leave_room
findings.generalLesson: Do not infer that cyclical low PE is automatically a value trap. Here the selected stock was de-rated, earnings conversion was realized, forward valuation was low, and it beat both higher-quality/less-torqued controls decisively.

findings.frozenDecision: 通威股份 High-priority sector_confirmed over 特变电工/隆基绿能
findings.postOutcomeDiagnosis: The selected company remained the best frozen PV expression at 60d, but the opportunity itself failed the benchmark-alpha test. The memo correctly observed a low ~13x 2022E PE and explicitly lower 2023 consensus profit, yet still treated short-run shortage persistence as sufficient expectation room.
findings.rootCause: Point PE and near-term realized earnings were insufficient. Consensus already encoded that 2022 was a peak-like earnings year. The thesis needed evidence that the whole forward earnings path—not merely Q2/Q3 profit—would improve versus that baseline.
findings.generalLesson: For cyclical super-profits, low current-year PE can be a peak-earnings optical discount. High-priority requires a thesis that changes the duration or shape of the forward earnings path, not only evidence that current earnings remain excellent.

findings.frozenDecision: 长安汽车 Research selection because post-lockdown earnings were proxy-only and 20d/60d price had already rerated strongly
findings.rootCause: V1.1 correctly recognized expectation absorption risk but may be too conservative when a recovery has only just become operational, forward valuation remains moderate, and incremental earnings have not yet been reported.
findings.generalLesson: Sustained strength is not synonymous with exhaustion. A future rule must distinguish prior rerating that fully capitalizes a mature earnings path from rerating that precedes a genuinely new operating/earnings leg. Do not relax V1.1 from this single case.

positiveCounterexample.pattern: cyclical low PE plus de-rated price and realized earnings torque; selected stock strongly outperformed benchmark and peers

crossWindowExpectationPathCheck.interpretation: The same underlying limitation now appears across different companies and industries: point valuation plus current earnings does not describe expectation burden. What matters is the shape and duration of the earnings path already embedded in market expectations. The Yankuang counterexample shows the fix must be path-aware rather than a blanket anti-cyclical or anti-low-PE rule.

decision.reason: Expectation-path/duration misread now has cross-company and cross-industry evidence (BYD premium-growth duration and Tongwei peak-cycle duration) plus a positive cyclical counterexample (Yankuang) that constrains the general rule.
decision.nextAction: Design V1.2 as a generic expectation-path/duration gate. It must compare frozen baseline earnings path with thesis path and require incremental path improvement for High-priority; it must not learn fixed PE, PEG, growth or momentum thresholds.

prohibitedUses: Do not alter V1.1 or any frozen 2022Q2 memo.
Do not create a rule that simply rejects high PE, low PE, cyclicals, sustained strength or forecast declines.
Do not learn numeric PE/growth thresholds from BYD, Tongwei or Yankuang.
Use 2022Q2 only as development evidence for V1.2; validate V1.2 on a new untouched holdout.
